subject: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Edgebank Ops <ops@edgebank.com>
Cc: Samantha Flores <samantha@cloudworkz.io>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan

Team / Edgebank ops —

This thread is the single source for tonight's staging->prod handoff for the private deployment (VPC) cutover. Please confirm readiness against the checklist below by EOD PST. If anything is not green, reply with the single-blocker and we'll decide go/no-go.

High-level plan (22:00 UTC window):
- Freeze inbound non-admin traffic at 21:50 UTC (DNS TTL set to 60s).
- BGP session failover test with secondary IX at +10m.
- PVC/NFS mounts validation for model weights across all inference nodes.
- KV cache warmup priming (script attached).
- Canary run: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% after 30m green.
- Post-deploy smoke tests: health endpoints, latencies (p50/p95), token throughput, and functional prompts set.

Go/no-go checklist (reply with YES/NO and short note):
1) Firewall rules pushed (internal and customer ACLs) — Edgebank ops
2) Certificates deployed to load balancers — Kimberly
3) NFS mounts validated on all nodes — Marissa
4) KV cache priming script available — Vivek (attached)
5) Runbook accessible and updated with rollback steps — Jonas
6) SRE on-call / escalation pager set — all

Attachments: runbook-v2.md, kvcache-warmup-script.sh

If Edgebank needs a maintenance window announcement to customers, confirm the copy and time.

— Jonas
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Edgebank Ops <ops@edgebank.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan

Jonas —

Quick status update:
- Firewall rules: pushed and validated from staging -> prod account (tested with curl from allowed CIDR).
- Certificates: certs deployed to LB and validated via openssl s_client (no chain issues).
- NFS mounts: 4/5 inference nodes show stable mounts; node inf-03 had a delayed mount on staging earlier this morning — I ran the remount script and collected dmesg (attached to my note). We'll keep inf-03 on watch during the canary.
- Runbook: I've added a short NFS rollback step (step 4.3) and a note on forced kube-svc restart. Link to runbook in related_links.
- SRE on-call: Paige will be primary; I'm secondary. Pager: +1 (650) 555-0199.

Open question: we should ensure that the model weights checksum after NFS mount matches the bundle manifest. I can run a checksum pass during the warmup window; estimate 6 minutes.

Reply YES to proceed once Edgebank confirms firewall window.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Infra PM — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: nfs-dmesg-inf-03.txt
From: Edgebank Ops <ops@edgebank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan

Jonas / team —

We confirm the firewall changes can be applied in the 21:50 UTC window. A couple of notes from our side:
- We'll coordinate the BGP secondary plug-in at +10m and will notify our peering partner.
- No cert rotation required on our edge appliance; SSL termination stays at the Redwood LB.
- Maintenance announcement: please send the 15-word customer notice (we will forward to our customers at T-30m).

One ask: will there be an IP change for any of the internal control plane endpoints? If yes, we need to update our ACLs immediately.

— Tomas Ortega
Ops Lead, Edgebank
ops@edgebank.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Edgebank Ops <ops@edgebank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan

All —

Checklist notes from infra/runtime:
- KV cache warmup script uploaded (kvcache-warmup-script.sh). It primes keys for the most frequent prefix distribution we saw in the last week. Run with ./kvcache-warmup-script.sh --dataset edgebank-top1000. Expect 8-12 minutes for full warmup on the dedicated 4xA100 pool.
- No IP changes to control-plane endpoints; only NAT mapping at the LB level for external customer traffic. Edgebank: no changes to your ACLs required.
- We added an extra liveness probe increase (initialDelay 15s -> 45s) for the model server on inf-03 to reduce premature restarts while the NFS finishes mount.
- I attached a short smoke test script that hits /health, /v1/generate (small prompt), and a token-throughput endpoint. The smoke test will fail fast and surface error codes to PagerDuty if >5% of canary requests fail.

On-call rota: Vivek (lead deploy), Paige (SRE), Marissa (infra PM), Jonas (exec up). Pager duty runbook referenced in runbook-v2.md.

— Vivek
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Edgebank Ops <ops@edgebank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T19:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan

Go for deploy at 22:00 UTC — CONFIRMED.

Acceptance / quick verification matrix (post-deploy):
- LB health (all backends): HTTP 200 /health for 30 consecutive checks across zones.
- P50 latency < 80ms, P95 < 240ms for the small prompt set (attached smoke-test-report template).
- Model weight checksum match across all nodes (script returns OK).
- KV hit-rate >= 60% within 20 minutes of warmup.
- No node OOMs; if any OOMs, follow runbook step 4.2 for oom-kill analysis and rollback to previous model bundle.

I will kick the checksum/pass and run the warmup at 21:40 UTC. Edgebank: please send the maintenance announcement at T-30.

Marissa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Edgebank Ops <ops@edgebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T22:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prod Handoff: go/no-go checklist and sanity verification plan

Post-deploy readout: quick summary —
- Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% completed, 35 minutes total.
- Smoke checks: /health OK across all zones; p50 62ms, p95 190ms (within target).
- KV warmup: achieved 67% hit-rate at T+18m.
- NFS: inf-03 had one delayed mount and the kube liveness probe triggered an OOM restart on model-container; runbook step 4.2 applied (increase probe delay + restart), container stabilized and checks resumed. Root cause: transient NFS latency under load; we flagged this for the infra backlog.
- No customer-facing errors observed; Edgebank confirmed successful internal tests.

Attachments: smoke-test-report-20261011.pdf (full metrics), runbook-v2.md (finalized).

Thanks to everyone for the quick coordination. Leaving the runbook as the canonical post-deploy reference; I'll open INF-729 to track the inf-03 NFS latency fix.

— Jonas
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
